positive_factors.description: Capital budget ($250,000 USD equivalent) provides solid initial runway.
Industry sector 'Software' has active ecosystem representation in training data.
Location (USA, CA) evaluated within corresponding regional cohort.

ml_model_evaluation.interpretation_note: Relative success likelihood evaluated against historical resolved ventures (exit vs closure). Because unresolved operating ventures are excluded from the training sample, this score represents a relative rank-ordered likelihood rather than an absolute population base-rate probability.

operational_formula_estimates.calculation_source: User-entered expected revenue and expenses (deterministic formula, NOT an ML prediction)
operational_formula_estimates.disclaimer: Revenue and profit figures are derived from user-entered expected revenue and expenses via standard financial formulas (MRR x 12, Revenue - Annual Expenses). They are NOT machine learning predictions. The ONLY machine learning prediction is relative success likelihood.

warnings: Location tier 'Tier 1' used as ecosystem proxy (mapped to Tier 1 US (CA / Silicon Valley))

Domain limitation: Training cohort consists of VC-backed tech startups (circa 2015 Crunchbase data). Capital raised acts as a cumulative historical proxy for founder starting budget. Predictions may have lower relevance for non-tech, lifestyle, or brick-and-mortar small businesses.
